rv.q: If you like to be laughing one minute and gripping the arms of your seat – or maybe your companion – the next, then this terrific new thriller is the theatrical brew for you.
It's the technical accomplishments that linger in the memory, with a cryptful of artist-magicians in keen collaboration.
Paranormal Activity is an experience that will haunt you – in a thrilling way – well after it’s over.
It lured me in and never let go.
At times it virtually threatens to freeze the marrow in your bones, with an exhilarating freshness of invention.
If anything, experiencing those scares alongside hundreds of strangers makes them even more unforgettable.
If you are a fan of the "PARANORMAL ACTIVITY" supernatural horror film franchise created by Oren Peli , then you will love this inspired play entry of the series.

cn.t: Critics praise this stage adaptation for successfully translating screen scares to live theater through immersive tech and sharp direction, blending genuine horror with humor for a thrilling, gripping experience.
